description:
Create a classic bouncing ball animation in Blender.

Starting with the loaded baseline scene:
1. Add a UV Sphere to the scene. Position it high up (e.g., Z=4) at a starting location (e.g., X=-6).
2. Animate the sphere to bounce on the ground (Z=0) at least 3 times. The ball must travel horizontally across the scene while bouncing.
3. Ensure the animation timing is realistic (ball accelerates down, decelerates up).
4. Set the timeline playback range to start at frame 1 and end at frame 120.
5. Save the project to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/bouncing_ball.blend'.

Login: The desktop session is already active. Blender is open with the baseline scene loaded.
